full_prompt_en: A square painterly streetscape shows a pale golden studio building rising above a palm-lined city intersection under a clear azure sky. Loose, visible strokes give the scene the warmth of an oil painting while preserving the recognizable geometry of the street. The upper edge is mostly blue, crossed by thin wisps of cream cloud and interrupted by a rooftop sign. On that sign, a flowing pale word reads "Disney" above large block letters reading "STUDIO". The central building has a stepped Art Deco tower, narrow blue windows, and vertical ribs that catch the bright sun. Its lower corner curves toward the viewer beneath a broad marquee; smaller letters on the marquee appear indistinct at this scale. From this corner, a long light-colored wing recedes to the right, its rows of windows and small awnings gradually losing sharpness in the distance. At the far left, shorter storefronts and a slim palm tree line the side street, with muted hills visible behind them. A taller palm stands near the right edge, its dark trunk dividing the sunlit facade from the blue sky and its fronds scattered across the upper corner. Traffic lights and utility lines make narrow dark accents in front of the building. A few small cars and street fixtures sit along the distant curbs, while the wide asphalt intersection fills the foreground with deep blue-gray shadow and several pale road markings. The main entrance is recessed beneath the marquee, a dark opening framed by bright walls and tiny green plants. Strong daylight arrives from the left, turning the tower cream and warm ochre and leaving the street and lower right facade in cooler shade. Short broken brush marks and softly blended patches suggest masonry, foliage, clouds, and asphalt without polishing away the painted surface. The overall composition balances a tall luminous tower against low receding streets, using warm architectural planes and saturated blue shadows for a cheerful cinematic mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画式街景呈现浅金色摄影棚建筑，在棕榈树环绕的城市路口和澄澈的蔚蓝天空下高高升起。松动可见的笔触赋予画面油画般的温度，同时保留街道清晰可辨的几何结构。上边缘大多是蓝色，被几缕奶油色薄云穿过，并由屋顶招牌打断。招牌上，浅色流线字写着"Disney"，下方的大号方正字母写着"STUDIO"。中央建筑有层层收进的装饰艺术塔楼、狭长蓝色窗户和接住明亮阳光的竖向肋线。其下部街角在宽大雨棚下向观者弯出；雨棚上的较小字样以此尺度看不清楚。从这个街角，一段浅色长翼向右后方延伸，成排窗户和小遮阳棚随着距离渐渐模糊。最左侧，较矮的店面和一棵细长棕榈树沿支路排列，后方可见灰淡的山丘。一棵更高的棕榈树站在右缘附近，深色树干将受光立面与蓝天分开，树叶散布在上角。交通灯和电线在建筑前构成细窄的深色点缀。远处路沿旁有几辆小车和街道设施，宽阔的沥青路口占据前景，带有深蓝灰色阴影及几道浅色路面标线。主入口退入雨棚下方，是被明亮墙面和几株细小绿植围住的深色开口。强烈日光从左侧照来，把塔楼染成奶油色与暖赭色，使街面及右下立面留在较冷的阴影中。短促断续的笔痕和柔和交融的色块表现砖石、树叶、云朵与沥青，同时保留鲜明的绘画表面。整体构图以高耸明亮的塔楼平衡低矮后退的街道，用温暖建筑色面和饱和蓝色阴影营造愉快的电影感。
style_prompt_en: The painterly image combines legible geometry with loose, broken strokes that leave colored marks visible across broad surfaces. Warm cream and golden ochre occupy the main illuminated masses, while saturated cerulean and blue-gray organize open space and deep shade. Narrow dark linear accents hold together larger softened forms without outlining every edge. Sunlight strikes upper planes sharply, then the color falls into cooler, more fluid shadows below. Small flecks of green and red animate the warm-cool structure without competing with its broad value pattern. Perspective lines converge gently toward a distant side of the frame, and vertical accents interrupt a low horizontal base. Texture alternates between scumbled opaque patches and smoother blended transitions, giving solid forms a lively painted vibration. The overall visual effect is bright, nostalgic, and cinematic, with color temperature and visible brushwork carrying the strongest identity.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅绘画式图像把清楚的几何结构与松动、断续的笔触结合起来，在大面积表面留下可见的色彩笔痕。暖奶油色和金赭色占据主要受光体块，饱和的蔚蓝与蓝灰组织开阔空间和深影。狭窄深色线性点缀把更大、更柔的形体连在一起，却不为每条边缘描线。阳光鲜明地落在上方平面，色彩随后向下方更冷、更流动的阴影过渡。少量绿与红的色点活跃冷暖结构，却不与宽阔的明度格局争夺注意力。透视线缓缓汇向画面远侧，竖向重音打断低平的水平基底。肌理在擦开的不透明色块和较平顺的混合过渡之间交替，使坚实形体产生生动的绘画颤动。整体视觉效果明亮、怀旧而有电影感，色温和可见笔触构成最鲜明的识别特征。
theme_en: A sunlit studio building at a palm-lined street corner
theme_zh: 阳光下棕榈树环绕的街角摄影棚建筑
name: Disney Studio
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
